name: My Long rice paper
summary: Rice paper from sticky rice and coconut milk, with sugar, salt, sesame, and sometimes milk or egg. The provincial tourism portal gives two origins and does not choose: elders say about 100 years, and another story ties the dry rations to the Nguyễn–Trịnh years. Listed with Sơn Đốc by Quyết định số 4069/QĐ-BVHTTDL on 30 October 2018. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Mỹ Lồng, old xã Mỹ Thạnh, Giồng Trôm. The portal’s 20 May 2024 article is the source for the craft.
history: The portal prints both origin lines and does not choose: about 100 years, from the elders, and a dry-ration story from the Nguyễn–Trịnh years.
Quyết định số 4069/QĐ-BVHTTDL, 30 October 2018, listed this paper and bánh phồng Sơn Đốc as national intangible heritage.
howToEat: Grill it as a snack, or carry it home. The portal says the old use was the Tết altar. The yards run all year and longer near Tết.
A price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: Mỹ Lồng, old xã Mỹ Thạnh, huyện Giồng Trôm. Clause 92 of Nghị quyết 1687/NQ-UBTVQH15 merges Mỹ Thạnh, Thuận Điền, and Lương Phú into xã Lương Phú and does not erase the craft name. A kilometer from town is check on arrival.
seoTitle: My Long rice paper — Ben Tre’s coconut sheet
seoDescription: Bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng is sticky-rice paper with coconut milk. Two origin stories stand. Heritage listing 30 October 2018. The price is check on arrival.
